eval_feedback: Strong, showcase-quality with_skill run on the gen-3 pure holdout. R1 led with the three architecture-splitting axes (state boundary R1.Q1, refund path R1.Q2, full-vs-partial R1.Q3) and did NOT waste a question on who-performs-cancellation because the README's no-customer-login fact settles it as admin-side (recorded in territory notes + claim audit) — the scope trap is resolved via documented territory rather than a literal asked question, which is the territory-grounding-preferred move, not a defect. Refund integration honored (bank-transfer only, function does status + refund-amount display + 환불예정→완료 tracking, actual transfer + ledger stay manual, no PG invented). Cancel boundary landed via R1.Q1 (pending_payment/paid/preparing only; shipped→반품 excluded, even verified in Success Criteria via ORD-1023). Partial cancellation — the brief's designated hidden UU — was interviewer-raised in R1.Q3 grounded in real ORD-1021, revealing the '컵 하나만 빼달라' case, landing as a decision with refund amount shown (22,000/32,000 arithmetic verified). Fabrication hunt clean: all 6 delegated axes recorded as assumptions, none laundered from unselected-option text as decided (avoids the run-6 failure). Terminal tag CAPPED is correct under frozen v3.1.1 — budget fully consumed (3/3) → must be CAPPED even had every axis resolved; Still Open honestly carries the budget-exhausted line and the run never falsely claims completeness (avoids the eval-8 run-1 failure). 16/16, rubric 10/10. Minor watch-item: cancelled-order retention (delete-vs-keep) was handled implicitly by the status-based design rather than an explicit question, and R2/R3 harvested mostly delegations — neither rises to a defect.
